entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: info(...) second argument must be a label selector, got %T
entries.rationale: The reference engine's evalInfo itself type-asserts args[1] to *parser.VectorSelector; a non-selector vector second argument is not a meaningful info label-selector and the guard mirrors that upstream assumption rather than panicking on the cast. infoSeriesMayCarryBucketBound calls it on a call the parser already accepted as info, and answers true on the error rather than surfacing it, so no query reaches the message through that caller either.
